description: Get an MP's attendance in votings for every sitting day of a term: how many votings were held, how many the MP took part in or missed, and whether the absence was excused. Use a sitting number and date from here with get-mp-votings to see the votes themselves.

id.description: ID of the MP (poseł): the `id` field from get-members

term.description: Term of the Sejm (kadencja), e.g. 10; defaults to the current term (see get-terms)

name: get-mp-voting-stats

numVoted.description: Votings the MP took part in

notice.description: Set when the Sejm API is unavailable and the data comes from a cache; it may be out of date

title: Get an MP's voting attendance
